library(bib2df)
library(dplyr)

# Helper function for null coalescing
null_or <- function(x, y) if(is.null(x) || is.na(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x

# Function to safely get a value or default
safe_get <- function(value, default = "") {
  if(is.null(value) || length(value) == 0 || all(is.na(value))) {
    return(default)
  }
  # Handle different data types and take first element
  result <- as.character(value[1])
  if(is.na(result) || result == "NA") {
    return(default)
  }
  return(result)
}

# Function to extract year more robustly
extract_year <- function(pub) {
  # Try multiple year fields that might exist
  year_value <- NULL
  
  if(!is.null(pub$YEAR) && !all(is.na(pub$YEAR))) {
    year_value <- pub$YEAR[1]
  } else if(!is.null(pub$DATE) && !all(is.na(pub$DATE))) {
    year_value <- pub$DATE[1]
  } else if(!is.null(pub$PUBDATE) && !all(is.na(pub$PUBDATE))) {
    year_value <- pub$PUBDATE[1]
  }
  
  if(is.null(year_value) || is.na(year_value)) {
    return(0)
  }
  
  # Convert to character first, then extract year
  year_str <- as.character(year_value)
  
  # Extract 4-digit year from various formats
  year_match <- regmatches(year_str, regexpr("\\b(19|20)\\d{2}\\b", year_str))
  
  if(length(year_match) > 0) {
    return(as.numeric(year_match[1]))
  } else {
    # Try direct conversion
    year_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year_str))
    if(!is.na(year_num) && year_num > 1900 && year_num < 2030) {
      return(year_num)
    }
  }
  
  return(0)
}

# Function to bold your name in author lists (APSA style)
bold_name <- function(authors) {
  if(is.null(authors) || length(authors) == 0) return("")
  
  # Convert to proper string - handle both character vectors and lists
  if(is.list(authors)) {
    authors_str <- paste(unlist(authors), collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    authors_str <- paste(authors, collapse = ", ")
  }
  
  # Clean up any formatting issues
  authors_str <- gsub('c\\("', '', authors_str)
  authors_str <- gsub('"\\)', '', authors_str)
  authors_str <- gsub('"', '', authors_str)
  
  # Bold different name formats
  authors_str <- gsub("Cameron Wimpy", "**Cameron Wimpy**", authors_str, fixed = TRUE)
  authors_str <- gsub("Wimpy, Cameron", "**Wimpy, Cameron**", authors_str, fixed = TRUE)
  authors_str <- gsub("C. Wimpy", "**C. Wimpy**", authors_str, fixed = TRUE)
  authors_str <- gsub("Wimpy, C.", "**Wimpy, C.**", authors_str, fixed = TRUE)
  
  return(authors_str)
}

# Function to format citation in APSA style
format_apsa_citation <- function(pub, pub_type) {
  authors <- bold_name(pub$AUTHOR)
  year <- pub$year_clean  # Use the cleaned year from our processing
  title <- safe_get(pub$TITLE, "No Title")
  
  if(pub_type == "article") {
    journal <- safe_get(pub$JOURNAL, "Journal")
    volume <- safe_get(pub$VOLUME)
    number <- safe_get(pub$NUMBER)
    pages <- safe_get(pub$PAGES)
    
    # APSA format: Author. Year. "Title." Journal Volume(Number): Pages.
    citation <- paste0(authors, ". ", year, ". \"", title, ".\" *", journal, "*")
    
    if(volume != "") {
      citation <- paste0(citation, " ", volume)
      if(number != "") {
        citation <- paste0(citation, "(", number, ")")
      }
    }
    
    if(pages != "") {
      # Clean up page formatting
      pages_clean <- gsub("--", "-", pages)
      citation <- paste0(citation, ": ", pages_clean)
    }
    
    citation <- paste0(citation, ".")
    
  } else if(pub_type == "book") {
    publisher <- safe_get(pub$PUBLISHER, "Publisher")
    address <- safe_get(pub$ADDRESS)
    
    # APSA format: Author. Year. Title. Location: Publisher.
    citation <- paste0(authors, ". ", year, ". *", title, "*.")
    if(address != "" && publisher != "") {
      citation <- paste0(authors, ". ", year, ". *", title, "*. ", address, ": ", publisher, ".")
    } else if(publisher != "") {
      citation <- paste0(authors, ". ", year, ". *", title, "*. ", publisher, ".")
    }
    
  } else if(pub_type == "incollection") {
    booktitle <- safe_get(pub$BOOKTITLE, "Book Title")
    editor <- safe_get(pub$EDITOR)
    publisher <- safe_get(pub$PUBLISHER, "Publisher")
    pages <- safe_get(pub$PAGES)
    address <- safe_get(pub$ADDRESS)
    
    # APSA format: Author. Year. "Title." In Book Title, ed. Editor, pages. Location: Publisher.
    citation <- paste0(authors, ". ", year, ". \"", title, ".\" In *", booktitle, "*")
    
    if(editor != "" && !is.na(editor)) {
      # Convert editor to character and handle multiple editors
      editor_str <- as.character(editor)
      if(length(editor_str) > 1) {
        editor_clean <- paste(editor_str, collapse = " and ")
      } else {
        editor_clean <- gsub(" and ", " and ", editor_str, fixed = TRUE)
      }
      citation <- paste0(citation, ", ed. ", editor_clean)
    }
    
    if(pages != "") {
      pages_clean <- gsub("--", "-", pages)
      citation <- paste0(citation, ", ", pages_clean)
    }
    
    citation <- paste0(citation, ".")
    
    if(address != "" && publisher != "") {
      citation <- paste0(citation, " ", address, ": ", publisher, ".")
    } else if(publisher != "") {
      citation <- paste0(citation, " ", publisher, ".")
    }
    
  } else if(pub_type == "inproceedings") {
    booktitle <- safe_get(pub$BOOKTITLE, "Conference")
    address <- safe_get(pub$ADDRESS)
    month <- safe_get(pub$MONTH)
    
    # APSA format: Author. Year. "Title." Paper presented at Conference, Location, Month.
    citation <- paste0(authors, ". ", year, ". \"", title, ".\" Paper presented at ", booktitle)
    
    if(address != "") {
      citation <- paste0(citation, ", ", address)
    }
    
    if(month != "") {
      citation <- paste0(citation, ", ", month)
    }
    
    citation <- paste0(citation, ".")
    
  } else {
    # Default format for other types (working papers, etc.)
    howpublished <- safe_get(pub$HOWPUBLISHED)
    if(howpublished != "") {
      citation <- paste0(authors, ". ", year, ". \"", title, ".\" ", howpublished, ".")
    } else {
      citation <- paste0(authors, ". ", year, ". \"", title, ".\" Working paper.")
    }
  }
  
  return(citation)
}

# Function to determine publication type and sort order
get_pub_type <- function(category, custom_pubtype = "") {
  # First check if there's a custom pubtype field
  if(custom_pubtype != "" && !is.na(custom_pubtype)) {
    custom_type <- tolower(custom_pubtype)
    
    custom_mapping <- list(
      "journal" = list(name = "Journal Articles", order = 1),
      "article" = list(name = "Journal Articles", order = 1),
      "book" = list(name = "Books", order = 2),
      "chapter" = list(name = "Book Chapters", order = 3),
      "incollection" = list(name = "Book Chapters", order = 3),
      "essay" = list(name = "Essays & Reviews", order = 4),
      "review" = list(name = "Essays & Reviews", order = 4),
      "essayreview" = list(name = "Essays & Reviews", order = 4)
    )
    
    if(custom_type %in% names(custom_mapping)) {
      return(custom_mapping[[custom_type]])
    }
  }
  
  # Fall back to automatic detection from bib category
  category <- tolower(safe_get(category, "misc"))
  
  type_mapping <- list(
    "article" = list(name = "Journal Articles", order = 1),
    "book" = list(name = "Books", order = 2),
    "incollection" = list(name = "Book Chapters", order = 3),
    "misc" = list(name = "Essays & Reviews", order = 4)
  )
  
  if(category %in% names(type_mapping)) {
    return(type_mapping[[category]])
  } else {
    # Default everything else to Essays & Reviews
    return(list(name = "Essays & Reviews", order = 4))
  }
}

# Function to determine publication type manually
get_manual_pubtype <- function(title, bibtex_key, category) {
  title_lower <- tolower(title)
  key_lower <- tolower(bibtex_key)
  
  # Manual mapping for specific entries
  if(grepl("review of:", title_lower) || 
     grepl("reflections on", title_lower) ||
     grepl("defining opposition", title_lower) ||
     key_lower %in% c("wimpy2024essay", "reid2013defining", "wimpy2011presidential", "wimpy2010review")) {
    return("essay")
  }
  
  # Default based on category
  return("")
}

# Function to create individual BibTeX citation file
create_bibtex_citation <- function(pub, pub_type) {
  authors <- safe_get(pub$AUTHOR)
  year <- pub$year_clean
  title <- safe_get(pub$TITLE, "No Title")
  bibtex_key <- pub$bibtex_clean
  
  # Convert authors list to proper BibTeX format
  if(is.list(authors)) {
    authors_str <- paste(unlist(authors), collapse = " and ")
  } else {
    authors_str <- paste(authors, collapse = " and ")
  }
  
  # Clean up formatting
  authors_str <- gsub('c\\("', '', authors_str)
  authors_str <- gsub('"\\)', '', authors_str)
  authors_str <- gsub('"', '', authors_str)
  authors_str <- gsub(", ", " and ", authors_str)
  
  # Start building BibTeX entry
  bib_entry <- paste0("@", pub_type, "{", bibtex_key, ",\n")
  bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, "  author = {", authors_str, "},\n")
  bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, "  title = {", title, "},\n")
  bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, "  year = {", year, "}")
  
  # Add type-specific fields
  if(pub_type == "article") {
    journal <- safe_get(pub$JOURNAL)
    volume <- safe_get(pub$VOLUME)
    number <- safe_get(pub$NUMBER)
    pages <- safe_get(pub$PAGES)
    
    if(journal != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  journal = {", journal, "}")
    if(volume != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  volume = {", volume, "}")
    if(number != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  number = {", number, "}")
    if(pages != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  pages = {", pages, "}")
    
  } else if(pub_type == "book") {
    publisher <- safe_get(pub$PUBLISHER)
    address <- safe_get(pub$ADDRESS)
    
    if(publisher != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  publisher = {", publisher, "}")
    if(address != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  address = {", address, "}")
    
  } else if(pub_type == "incollection") {
    booktitle <- safe_get(pub$BOOKTITLE)
    editor <- safe_get(pub$EDITOR)
    publisher <- safe_get(pub$PUBLISHER)
    pages <- safe_get(pub$PAGES)
    address <- safe_get(pub$ADDRESS)
    
    if(booktitle != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  booktitle = {", booktitle, "}")
    if(editor != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  editor = {", editor, "}")
    if(publisher != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  publisher = {", publisher, "}")
    if(pages != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  pages = {", pages, "}")
    if(address != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  address = {", address, "}")
  }
  
  # Add DOI if available
  doi <- safe_get(pub$DOI)
  if(doi != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  doi = {", doi, "}")
  
  # Add URL if available
  url <- safe_get(pub$URL)
  if(url != "") bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, ",\n  url = {", url, "}")
  
  bib_entry <- paste0(bib_entry, "\n}")
  
  return(bib_entry)
}

# Read the bib file
pubs <- bib2df("publications.bib")

# Process publications
pubs_processed <- pubs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    year_clean = extract_year(cur_data()),
    title_clean = safe_get(TITLE, "No Title"),
    bibtex_clean = safe_get(BIBTEXKEY, paste0("ref_", row_number())),
    category_clean = tolower(safe_get(CATEGORY, "misc")),
    pubtype_clean = get_manual_pubtype(title_clean, bibtex_clean, category_clean)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Add type information
for(i in 1:nrow(pubs_processed)) {
  custom_pubtype <- pubs_processed$pubtype_clean[i]
  type_info <- get_pub_type(pubs_processed$category_clean[i], custom_pubtype)
  pubs_processed$type_name[i] <- type_info$name
  pubs_processed$type_order[i] <- type_info$order
}

# Sort by type and year
pubs_processed <- pubs_processed %>%
  arrange(type_order, desc(year_clean))

# Create citations folder if it doesn't exist
if(!dir.exists("citations")) {
  dir.create("citations")
}

# Generate individual BibTeX files
for(i in 1:nrow(pubs_processed)) {
  pub <- pubs_processed[i,]
  bib_content <- create_bibtex_citation(pub, pub$category_clean)
  bib_filename <- paste0("citations/", pub$bibtex_clean, ".bib")
  writeLines(bib_content, bib_filename)
}

# Get unique publication types
pub_types <- pubs_processed %>%
  distinct(type_name, type_order, category_clean) %>%
  arrange(type_order)

# Generate sections by publication type
for(type_idx in 1:nrow(pub_types)) {
  current_type <- pub_types$type_name[type_idx]
  current_category <- pub_types$category_clean[type_idx]
  
  # Get publications for this type
  type_pubs <- pubs_processed %>%
    filter(type_name == current_type) %>%
    arrange(desc(year_clean))
  
  if(nrow(type_pubs) > 0) {
    # Print section header
    cat("## ", current_type, "\n\n")
    
    # Generate entries for this type (numbered in descending order)
    for(i in 1:nrow(type_pubs)) {
      pub <- type_pubs[i,]
      
      # Format citation in APSA style
      citation <- format_apsa_citation(pub, current_category)
      
      # Print the entry with section numbering
      entry_number <- nrow(type_pubs) - i + 1
      cat(entry_number, ". ", citation, "\n\n", sep = "")
      
      # Create buttons section
      cat("\n::: {.publication-buttons}\n")
      
      # PDF button (only show if file exists)
      pdf_file <- paste0("uploads/", pub$bibtex_clean, ".pdf")
      if(file.exists(pdf_file)) {
        cat("[<i class=\"fas fa-file-pdf\"></i> PDF](", pdf_file, "){.btn-pub}", sep = "")
      }
      
      # DOI button
      doi <- safe_get(pub$DOI)
      if(doi != "") {
        doi_url <- if(startsWith(doi, "http")) doi else paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)
        cat("\n[<i class=\"fas fa-external-link-alt\"></i> DOI](", doi_url, "){.btn-pub}", sep = "")
      }
      
      # Publisher/Journal URL button
      url <- safe_get(pub$URL)
      if(url == "") url <- safe_get(pub$url)  # Check lowercase too
      if(url != "") {
        cat("\n[<i class=\"fas fa-external-link-alt\"></i> Publisher](", url, "){.btn-pub}", sep = "")
      }
      
      # Data button
      data_url <- safe_get(pub$DATA)
      if(data_url != "") {
        cat("\n[<i class=\"fas fa-database\"></i> Data](", data_url, "){.btn-pub}", sep = "")
      }
      
      # Code button
      code_url <- safe_get(pub$CODE)
      if(code_url == "") code_url <- safe_get(pub$code)  # Check lowercase too
      if(code_url != "") {
        cat("\n[<i class=\"fas fa-code\"></i> Code](", code_url, "){.btn-pub}", sep = "")
      }
      
      # Supplement button
      supplement_url <- safe_get(pub$SUPPLEMENT)
      if(supplement_url == "") supplement_url <- safe_get(pub$supplement)  # Check lowercase too
      if(supplement_url != "") {
        cat("\n[<i class=\"fas fa-paperclip\"></i> Supplement](", supplement_url, "){.btn-pub}", sep = "")
      }
      
      # Citation button (BibTeX popup)
      bib_content <- create_bibtex_citation(pub, current_category)
      # Escape quotes and newlines for JavaScript
      bib_content_escaped <- gsub("\"", "&quot;", bib_content)
      bib_content_escaped <- gsub("\n", "\\n", bib_content_escaped)
      cat("\n[<i class=\"fas fa-quote-right\"></i> Cite](#){.btn-pub .citation-btn data-citation=\"", bib_content_escaped, "\"}", sep = "")
      
      # Summary/Abstract toggle button (if abstract exists)
      full_abstract <- safe_get(pub$ABSTRACT)
      if(full_abstract == "") full_abstract <- safe_get(pub$abstract)  # Check lowercase too
      if(full_abstract != "" && nchar(full_abstract) > 0) {
        cat("\n[<i class=\"fas fa-align-left\"></i> Summary](#){.btn-pub .abstract-toggle data-target=\"abstract-", pub$bibtex_clean, "\"}", sep = "")
      }
      
      cat("\n:::\n")
      
      # Add hidden full abstract if it exists
      if(full_abstract != "" && nchar(full_abstract) > 0) {
        cat("\n::: {.abstract-full #abstract-", pub$bibtex_clean, " style=\"display: none; margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px; background-color: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #007bff;\"}\n", sep = "")
        cat("**Abstract:** ", full_abstract, "\n")
        cat(":::\n")
      }
      
      cat("\n")
    }
    
    cat("---\n\n")
  }
}

<script>
// JavaScript to handle abstract toggle functionality
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const toggleButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.abstract-toggle');
  
  toggleButtons.forEach(function(button) {
    button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const targetId = this.getAttribute('data-target');
      const abstractDiv = document.getElementById(targetId);
      
      if(abstractDiv) {
        if(abstractDiv.style.display === 'none' || abstractDiv.style.display === '') {
          abstractDiv.style.display = 'block';
          this.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-eye-slash"></i> Hide Summary';
        } else {
          abstractDiv.style.display = 'none';
          this.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-align-left"></i> Summary';
        }
      }
    });
  });
  
  // JavaScript to handle citation popup functionality
  const citationButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.citation-btn');
  
  citationButtons.forEach(function(button) {
    button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const citation = this.getAttribute('data-citation').replace(/\\n/g, '\n').replace(/&quot;/g, '"');
      
      // Create modal
      const modal = document.createElement('div');
      modal.style.cssText = `
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        z-index: 1000;
      `;
      
      const isDark = document.body.dataset.bsTheme === 'dark' || document.documentElement.dataset.bsTheme === 'dark';
      const bgColor = isDark ? '#1e293b' : 'white';
      const textColor = isDark ? '#f8fafc' : '#333';
      const mutedColor = isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#666';
      const borderColor = isDark ? '#334155' : '#ddd';
      const inputBg = isDark ? '#0f172a' : '#f8f9fa';

      const modalContent = document.createElement('div');
      modalContent.style.cssText = `
        background: ${bgColor};
        padding: 20px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        max-width: 600px;
        max-height: 70vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
        position: relative;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      `;

      modalContent.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 15px;">
          <h3 style="margin: 0; color: ${textColor};">BibTeX Citation</h3>
          <button id="closeModal" style="background: none; border: none; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; color: ${mutedColor};">&times;</button>
        </div>
        <textarea id="citationText" readonly style="
          width: 100%;
          height: 200px;
          font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
          font-size: 12px;
          border: 1px solid ${borderColor};
          border-radius: 4px;
          padding: 10px;
          resize: vertical;
          background-color: ${inputBg};
          color: ${textColor};
        ">${citation}</textarea>
        <div style="margin-top: 15px; text-align: right;">
          <button id="copyBtn" style="
            background-color: #007bff;
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            margin-right: 10px;
          ">Copy to Clipboard</button>
          <button id="closeBtn" style="
            background-color: #6c757d;
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
          ">Close</button>
        </div>
      `;
      
      modal.appendChild(modalContent);
      document.body.appendChild(modal);
      
      // Focus and select text
      const textarea = document.getElementById('citationText');
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.select();
      
      // Copy functionality
      document.getElementById('copyBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
        textarea.select();
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(citation).then(function() {
          const btn = document.getElementById('copyBtn');
          const originalText = btn.textContent;
          btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
          btn.style.backgroundColor = '#28a745';
          setTimeout(function() {
            btn.textContent = originalText;
            btn.style.backgroundColor = '#007bff';
          }, 2000);
        }).catch(function() {
          // Fallback for older browsers
          document.execCommand('copy');
          const btn = document.getElementById('copyBtn');
          const originalText = btn.textContent;
          btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
          btn.style.backgroundColor = '#28a745';
          setTimeout(function() {
            btn.textContent = originalText;
            btn.style.backgroundColor = '#007bff';
          }, 2000);
        });
      });
      
      // Close functionality
      function handleEscape(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          closeModal();
        }
      }

      function closeModal() {
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
        document.body.removeChild(modal);
      }

      document.getElementById('closeModal').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      document.getElementById('closeBtn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);

      // Close on background click
      modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === modal) {
          closeModal();
        }
      });

      // Close on Escape key
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
    });
  });
});
</script>
